title: fix(token-cost): duplicate same-attempt enter event drops stage start time in harvest join
body:
## Background

`token-cost-harvest.mjs`'s event-window join
(`src/scripts/token-cost-harvest.mts`, `#2418`/`#2425`/`#2444`) is
what promotes a local session sample to `kind: "issue-loop"`,
`outcome: "merged"` for the `#2296` roadmap's sample pool. It has
already needed several fixes for join gaps that silently dropped
completed issue-loops.

`readEventWindows`'s `enterAtByAttempt` map is keyed
`vendorSessionId -> latest enter timestamp` (see the
`enterAtByAttempt.set(key, byAttempt)` call near line 1080). A
*second* `enter` event from the same attempt (same `vendorSessionId`)
for the same `(issueNumber, vendor, stageId)` key, with no
intervening `exit`, silently overwrites the first enter's timestamp.
The stage's true start time is lost and the computed window narrows
to `[second-enter, exit)`.

This happens for real: a long-lived agent session that resumes after
a context-compaction restart and re-enters a phase (for example
`review`) it had already entered earlier in the same session, without
having logged an `exit` for the interrupted first entry, reproduces
this exactly.

### Evidence (2026-09-05, this workstation)

`events.jsonl` for issue `#2643`'s `review` stage:

```
enter review 2026-09-05T14:27:23.531Z  vendorSessionId=b17ac6fb...  claimId=678d3367...
enter review 2026-09-05T14:40:33.464Z  vendorSessionId=b17ac6fb...  claimId=678d3367...
exit  review 2026-09-05T14:48:04.462Z  vendorSessionId=b17ac6fb...  claimId=678d3367...
```

Symptom: a `token-cost-harvest.mjs --repo kurone-kito/idd-skill`
run performed right after PR #2650 (closing issue #2643) merged still
reports only 1 `issue-loop` sample, even though issues `#2619`,
`#2640`, `#2641`, `#2642`, and `#2643` all completed the same day with
full seven-stage `events.jsonl` coverage, valid GitHub `claimed-by`
markers, and confirmed merges. Each instead produced an
`#ew<issueNumber>` sample with `kind: "session"`,
`outcome: "unknown"`, and an oddly narrow or point-like window (for
example `#ew2641` had `startedAt === endedAt`), rather than being
promoted to `kind: "issue-loop"`, `outcome: "merged"`.

## Proposed change

Root-cause and fix `readEventWindows`'s (or the downstream per-issue
window assembly's) handling of a duplicate `enter` for the same
`(issueNumber, vendor, stageId, vendorSessionId)` key with no
intervening `exit`. Investigate whether preserving the *earliest*
enter per attempt (instead of last-write-wins), or merging the two
sub-windows, is correct here without breaking the existing
cross-attempt disambiguation this map also serves (`idCompatible`,
`isBoundaryConsistent`, the `#2432` claim-id-mismatch guard). Confirm
the fix against issue `#2643`'s recorded `events.jsonl` excerpt above,
and check whether `#2619`/`#2640`/`#2641`/`#2642` (a different
session, `ef176242-...`) share the same root cause or a distinct one
before generalizing the fix.

Regenerating `docs/token-cost-snapshot.json` is explicitly out of
scope for this issue -- that is a separate, later step once the
harvest join is trusted again.

## Acceptance criteria

- A unit test in `tests/token-cost-harvest.test.mts` reproduces a
  duplicate same-attempt `enter` (no intervening `exit`) for one
  stage and asserts the resulting window still covers the full true
  start-to-end span (or documents why narrowing is intentional),
  with every existing cross-attempt test still green.
- Running `node scripts/token-cost-harvest.mjs --repo
  kurone-kito/idd-skill --dry-run` after the fix reports more than 1
  `issue-loop` sample, or the harness's own doc comment records why
  `#2619`/`#2640`/`#2641`/`#2642` remain unjoined for a different,
  now-documented reason.
- `docs/token-cost-snapshot.json` is unchanged by this issue's PR.

## Candidate files

- `src/scripts/token-cost-harvest.mts`
- `tests/token-cost-harvest.test.mts`

Refs #2296
